paite: "Vai hawmsak kei un, vai hawmsak na hihlouhna ding un.
heading: Midangte Vaihawmsak Thu A Thuhilhna / (Luk 6.7-38,41-42)
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

paite: Na vai hawmsak mah bang un hawmsak in na om ding uh, na tehna ngei mah un hon tehsak nawn ding uh.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

paite: Huan bangziak a, nangmah mit a singtum om ngaihtuah lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik mu na hia?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

paite: Bangchi in na unau kiang ah, na mit a kipan huai ninneng neuchik hon lakhesak ve, na chih theih ding? Ngai in, nangmah mit mahmah ah singtum a-om nilouh ngal a.
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

paite: Milepchiah, na mit a kipan singtum lakhe masa in; huchi in na unau mit a kipan ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding kichiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

paite: "Ui kiang ah thil siangthou pe kei un; vok ma ah na tuikepsuang uh pai kei un, achilse kha ding ua, huan kihei in nang ahon balzak kha ding uh.
heading: Thil Siangthou Nitsakna
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

paite: "Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, hon honsak ding uh.
heading: Thum Ding A Thuhilhna / (Luk 11.9-13)
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

paite: Kuapeuh angen in angah a; kuapeuh azong in amu a; akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

paite: Ahihleh noute kuapeuh na tapa un tanghou ngen taleh, kua'n suang pe ding na hi ua?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

paite: Ahihkeileh ngasa ngen taleh, kua'n gul pe ding na hi ua?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

paite: Huchi hileh nou migilou in bawn, na tate uh thil hoih piakdan na theih un, na Pa uh van a om in angente thil hoih pe zaw sem lou ding hia?
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

paite: "Huaiziak in mi'n na tung ua thil bangpeuh hih ding a na deih bang uh, mi tung ah leng hih sam un; huai Dan leh zawlneite thu ahi him hi.
heading: Chindan Hoih
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

paite: "Kong kochik ah lut un; manthatna a paina kong aza a, alampi leng alian a, huai a lut tam leng atam mahmah uhi.
heading: Kong Kochik A Lutna / (Luk 13.24)
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

paite: Hinna a paina kong akochik a, alampi aneu a, atawnte tawmchik ahi uh.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

paite: "Zawlnei takloute lak ah pilvang un, amaute belam vun silh in na kiang uah ahong pai nak ua, asunglam uh nge duhgawl pipi ahi uh.
heading: Sing Leh Agah / (Luk 6.43-44)
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

paite: Amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uh. Khaulingnei gui ah grep gah alou ngei ua hia? Lenling ah theipi a lou ngei ua hia?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

paite: Huchi mah bang in sing hoih peuhmah agah ahoih a; sing sia agah ase nak.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

paite: Sing hoih agah ase thei kei, sing sia agah ahoih thei sam kei hi.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

paite: Sing chih gah hoih lou aphuk ua, mei ah apai uhi.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uhi.
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

paite: "Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na peuh van-gam ah alut kei ding uh; ka Pa van a om deihlam hihte alut ding uhi.
heading: Toupa Theih Mite
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi tampi'n, Toupa, na min in thute ka gen ua, na min in dawite ka delhkhia ua, na min in thillamdang tampi ka hih zel uh hilou hiam? achi ding uh.
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

paite: Huai hun chiang in, 'Nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka hon thei ngei kei, ka kiang a kipan paimang un, chi in amaute ka hilh ding hi.'
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

paite: "Huchi in michih hiai ka thu za a, zui peuhmah, mipil suangpi tung a inn lammi toh ka tehpih ding hi.
heading: Inn Lamdan Nihte / (Luk 6.47-49)
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

paite: Vuahpi hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; himahleh achim kei; suangpi tung a lepkip ahih ziak in.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

paite: Huan michih, hiai ka thu za a zom lou peuhmah, mihai piaunel tung a inn lammi toh ka teh ding hi.
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

paite: Vuah hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; achimta a, huai inn anakchip ngel hi," achi hi.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu agen zoh in, mipi'n athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uh;
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

paite: laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneihna neitak a amaute thu ahilh ziak in.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
